name: homeassistant.avado.dnp.dappnode.eth
title: Home Assistant (smart home)
shortDescription: Control your lights, heating and smart devices from one private app
description: Home Assistant brings your smart home together in one private app: lights, plugs, heating, sensors and cameras, with automations such as "lights off when everybody has left". Getting started: open Home Assistant, create your account and tell it where your home is. Add your devices under Settings, Devices & services. On your phone, install the free Home Assistant app and use the server address https://homeassistant.my.ava.do. Voice: with the Private Assistant installed, switch on voice in the Setup tab; Home Assistant then listens, answers and speaks on this box, without the cloud. Works: devices added by address or through their maker's account (Philips Hue, Shelly, MQTT, Wi-Fi plugs and cameras, Tuya). Not yet: devices found automatically on the home network (Apple HomeKit, some Chromecast and Sonos set-ups), Bluetooth and USB sticks (Zigbee, Z-Wave).
author: AVADO
